article.story: ARLINGTON, Texas -- — Cal Furnish scored 21 points as Oral Roberts beat UT Arlington 84-80 on Tuesday. Furnish shot 7 of 13 from the field, including 3 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 5 from the line for the Golden Eagles (4-3). Boden Williams scored 20 points while shooting 7 for 16, including 6 for 12 from beyond the arc. Chase Martin shot 5 of 6 from the field and 5 for 7 from the line to finish with 16 points. Noah Shelby finished with 23 points for the Mavericks (6-2). Tycen McDaniels added 19 points, 12 rebounds and two blocks for UT Arlington. Tristan Hankins finished with 11 points, eight rebounds, 10 assists and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
